unresolved_disagreements.topic: Immediate Multi-Agent Velocity vs. Structural Retention & Attribution Integrity

positions.technical_agent: Emphasizes immediate day-one velocity on LangGraph/CrewAI pipelines [R-EXP-01].
positions.hiring_manager_agent: Argues an engineer who departs after 7 months [R-EXP-01, T-A10] inflicts severe net negative ROI.
positions.skeptic_agent: Argues that unverified error metrics [T-A3] and resume inflation [T-A7] create catastrophic platform debt.

decision_path.original_gs_rationale: The General Secretary renders a definitive NO HIRE recommendation with HIGH confidence. While Rohan Malhotra possesses immediate domain familiarity and built planner/executor/reviewer multi-agent systems at Voltrix [R-EXP-01], serious credibility, attribution, and retention risks make this hire unviable. During cross-examination, he conceded that his resume claim of 'Sole architect' [R-EXP-03] was exaggerated, acknowledging that teammate Priya built most of the production system [T-A7]. Furthermore, he admitted that model routing was tuned ad-hoc without formal verification [T-A4], and his tenure pattern (3 jobs in 3.5 years, departing after only 7 months [R-EXP-01, T-A10]) presents extreme flight risk for a core platform role.

feedback.overall_summary: Rohan Malhotra demonstrated strong domain familiarity in freight logistics and practical experience with LangGraph and model routing. However, he received a NO HIRE recommendation due to critical concerns regarding attribution honesty (overstating solo architecture), high flight risk tenure patterns (3 jobs in 3.5 years, 7-month stay), and lack of rigorous quantitative observability. To improve, he must practice precise collaborative attribution, build multi-quarter tenure stability, and implement formal benchmark evaluation suites.

resume_improvements.current_issue: Resume claimed 'Sole architect' of freight exception system [R-EXP-03], but conceded in interview that teammate Priya built most of the production system [T-A7].
resume_improvements.recommendation: Accurately describe your contribution within team context; never claim solo ownership of multi-engineer platform projects.
resume_improvements.example_before: Sole architect of multi-agent freight exception handling platform using LangGraph.
resume_improvements.example_after: Co-developed multi-agent freight exception handling platform in a 3-person engineering squad; personally architected the model routing layer and document parser modules.

resume_improvements.current_issue: Claimed cost and error optimizations without instrumented metrics, telemetry logs, or evaluation benchmarks for reviewer agent overrides [T-A3, T-A4].
resume_improvements.recommendation: Include concrete latency distributions (p95/p99), token cost savings with dollar figures, and automated eval dataset results.
resume_improvements.example_before: Tuned model routing across GPT-4 and SLMs to reduce costs.
resume_improvements.example_after: Engineered dynamic model router across GPT-4o and fine-tuned Llama-3-8B, cutting per-request token costs by 48% while maintaining 94.2% extraction accuracy across 10,000 daily EDI transactions.

resume_improvements.current_issue: Frequent job transitions (3 roles in 3.5 years, departing Voltrix after only 7 months [R-EXP-01, T-A10]) creates severe flight-risk flags for hiring managers.
resume_improvements.recommendation: Provide clear contextual framing around project completion, acquisition, or scope transitions, and commit to longer tenures.
resume_improvements.example_after: AI Engineer (Contract/Platform Initiative) at Voltrix (7 mos) — Delivered v1 multi-agent freight extraction pipeline before planned platform handover.

required_skills.growth_path: Implement comprehensive OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and metrics dashboards for every agent deliberation turn and tool invocation.

required_skills.target_job_expectation: Statistical evaluation frameworks measuring hallucination, tool call failure rates, and reviewer agent override precision against gold-standard sets.
required_skills.current_candidate_level: Lacks quantitative evaluation metrics for agent error recovery [T-A3].
required_skills.growth_path: Build an automated evaluation harness with synthetic edge-case generation and regression scoring for agent supervisor loops.

required_skills.target_job_expectation: Proven track record operating mission-critical 24/7 services, managing SEV-1 incidents, and executing automated rollbacks.
required_skills.current_candidate_level: Untested in high-incident production environments despite on-call claims [T-A9].
required_skills.growth_path: Participate in formal on-call rotations, author post-mortems with preventative action items, and design circuit breakers for downstream LLM outages.

company_expectations.company_standard: Hiring panels rigorously cross-examine resume claims. Exaggerating contributions or claiming solo credit damages credibility irreparably.
company_expectations.assessment_finding: Critical gap. Candidate claimed 'Sole architect' [R-EXP-03] but conceded teammate Priya built most of the architecture [T-A7].
company_expectations.advice_for_future_interviews: Always speak about team achievements using 'we' for collective success and 'I' specifically for individual modules you personally designed and coded.

company_expectations.company_standard: Companies invest 3-6 months onboarding senior engineers and expect 2+ years of sustained platform development to realize positive ROI.
company_expectations.assessment_finding: High risk. 3 jobs in 3.5 years with a 7-month departure from Voltrix [R-EXP-01, T-A10].
company_expectations.advice_for_future_interviews: Demonstrate commitment to long-term ownership by staying at your next role for 2+ years and showing sustained feature evolution across multiple releases.

company_expectations.company_standard: AI systems in freight logistics require deterministic verification and auditable failure boundaries.
company_expectations.assessment_finding: Gap identified. Model routing was tuned via informal intuition rather than formal benchmark Pareto curves [T-A4].
company_expectations.advice_for_future_interviews: Present decisions using data: show tradeoff graphs between cost, latency, and accuracy with statistical confidence intervals.

persona_feedback.headline: High Flight Risk & Short Tenure Pattern
persona_feedback.feedback: Tenure history (3 jobs in 3.5 years, departing after 7 months [T-A10]) presents substantial team friction and retention costs.
persona_feedback.key_recommendation: Commit to long-term project lifecycles (24+ months) to establish credibility as a reliable engineering partner.

persona_feedback.headline: Attribution Discrepancy Undermined Candidacy
persona_feedback.feedback: Cross-examination revealed 'Sole architect' claim [R-EXP-03] was exaggerated over teammate Priya's contributions [T-A7].
persona_feedback.key_recommendation: Adopt radical honesty regarding team vs. individual contributions on all future resumes and interviews.

persona_feedback.headline: Negative Retention ROI for Core Role
persona_feedback.feedback: Onboarding overhead for a complex freight platform cannot be amortized over a 7-month tenure.
persona_feedback.key_recommendation: Demonstrate multi-year ownership of complex systems from design through sustained maintenance.

persona_feedback.headline: Good Framework Knowledge Hindered by Lack of Evaluation Rigor
persona_feedback.feedback: Demonstrated practical LangGraph/CrewAI familiarity [R-EXP-01], but lacked rigorous observability and automated error metrics [T-A3].
persona_feedback.key_recommendation: Instrument all agent workflows with automated evaluation harnesses (e.g. LangSmith, RAGAS) and distributed tracing.

persona_feedback.headline: Definitive No Hire Due to Attribution & Retention Risks
persona_feedback.feedback: While technical knowledge in freight agents is noted, credibility gaps and tenure instability make this unviable for a core hire.
persona_feedback.key_recommendation: Focus on building verifiable production systems with transparent attribution and long-term tenure track records.
